notes.title: Patch Notes - September 2024 Update!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=OZglR9RDZRk;full][/previewyoutube]

General Improvements
Overall Campaign Structure:
Reworked the main campaign progression to streamline pacing while enhancing narrative depth and immersion.

Improved difficulty scaling to ensure smoother progression for players across all levels.
Significant performance optimizations for all platforms, resulting in faster load times and reduced stuttering during high-intensity battles.
Audio and sound effects updated for more immersive environmental experiences and combat.
Stat Redistribution & Balance Changes
Character Adjustments

Hero Classes Rebalanced: Each class's core stats have been redistributed to ensure more unique roles in combat and encourage diverse playstyles.

AI improvements: Enemies now utilize more advanced tactics, including flanking maneuvers and synergistic abilities in group encounters.
Elite enemies:
Health reduced by 10% to prevent drawn-out battles.
Attack power increased by 8% to maintain their threat level.
Equipment Overhaul

Armor sets and weapon stats rebalanced to promote more synergy between gear and class abilities.
Introduced diminishing returns on stacking similar stat bonuses from equipment, encouraging more varied loadouts.
New Encounters
Dynamic World Events:

New dynamic world events added to various regions of the campaign map. These encounters will change based on player actions and choices, affecting the surrounding environment.
The Cursed Caravan: A group of wandering merchants is under attack by ethereal bandits—choose to save them or take advantage of the chaos for personal gain.
Ancient Wyrm Awakening: Players may now encounter a previously dormant dragon while traversing mountain ranges. Engage in a multi-phase boss fight with unique mechanics based on terrain.
New Elite Enemy Units:

Stormforged Colossus: A towering elemental that controls the power of lightning, newly added to desert and mountain regions.
Soulreaper Phantoms: Stealthy and lethal enemies that stalk players in shadowed dungeons. These enemies have increased evasion and critical damage but are vulnerable to light-based attacks.
Revamped Existing Bosses:

Bosses in major campaign storylines have received mechanical updates to make fights more challenging and rewarding:
Lord Balvour's Fight: Now includes a second phase where he channels dark magic, transforming the arena and gaining new devastating AOE abilities.
Queen Seraphine: She now summons ethereal wings in her final phase, adding aerial mobility and summoning protective wards that players must destroy.

New Secret Level: The Forgotten Sanctum
How to Unlock:
Players must gather three hidden relics found in obscure, hard-to-reach areas of the campaign. Once collected, these relics reveal the entrance to the Forgotten Sanctum, an ancient temple filled with forgotten magics and untold treasures.

Features of the Forgotten Sanctum:
New Puzzle Mechanics: Players must solve complex puzzles using a combination of light and dark magic to progress through the temple.

Unique Boss Encounter: Face the Ancient Architect, a sentient being who manipulates the temple’s layout and alters the environment during battle. Defeating him rewards players with a unique artifact that boosts stats and provides a game-changing ability.

Lore-Rich Environment: The Sanctum is filled with hidden tomes and tapestries that reveal deep, previously unexplored lore of the game's world and its forgotten civilizations.

Hidden Chests & Secret Paths: Explore every nook and cranny of the temple to uncover legendary loot and hidden shortcuts that change how players navigate future playthroughs.

Miscellaneous Improvements

Map Improvements: Added new fast travel points and optimized mini-map visibility for better navigation.
UI/UX Updates: Reworked inventory and skill management interfaces for easier access to important information during intense combat.
New Cosmetic Options: Players can now unlock new armor skins and weapon visual effects through campaign milestones and achievements.

Bug Fixes
Fixed an issue where players could get stuck during certain dialogue sequences.
Resolved a bug where damage-over-time abilities would occasionally not apply their effects correctly.
Corrected visual glitches that occurred when rapidly switching between different armor sets in the inventory menu.

Closing Note:
This patch revitalizes the main campaign, offering new strategic challenges, fresh encounters, and hidden rewards for seasoned veterans and newcomers alike. We look forward to seeing how you tackle the new Forgotten Sanctum and adapt to the stat redistributions across classes.

notes.title: DEAD GET REKT v.2: Early Access Update - Get Wrecked Like Never Before!
notes.content:
[h3][b]DEAD GET REKT v.2: Early Access Update - Get Wrecked Like Never Before![/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921935/d88ae56f124fbdaa5cb3423aba6b416878076e15.png[/img]

Major Revamps & Early Access Enhancements:
Class Act: All character classes have received a significant overhaul! Get ready for a smoother and more engaging experience as all classes are now tougher, stronger and more unique as you explore the depths of the game in Early Access.
Elite Encounters: Brace yourselves! Brand new elite enemies with unique attack patterns and mechanics have been unleashed. Prepare your strategies and test your mettle against these fearsome foes.
Crypt Crawls Get Spookier: Descend into the crypt and face entirely new enemy groups that will challenge your survival skills.
We're excited to see how these changes shake up your DEAD GET REKT experience! Keep the feedback coming as we continue to refine the Early Access journey.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44921935/6f2c7398b3740ec6e611c318a9c81e32f4214301.png[/img]
